content.summary: Building operations company Johnson Controls (NYSE:JCI) reported Q3 CY2025 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 3.1% year on year to $6.44 billion. On the other hand, next quarter’s revenue guidance of $5.59 billion was less impressive, coming in 2.5% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.26 per share was 4.7% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
